0021Literacy and numeracy

Anthroly RL Environment Sample (Synthetic)

sarathkavuru/anthroly-rl-env-sample

Answer 40 easy synthetic prompts (arithmetic, strings, units, code reasoning) that a short Python grader scores as 0 or 1.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • format example of RLVR tasks with graders
  • CI smoke test for an RL stack

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

Each task ships a Python grade(response) function returning 0.0 or 1.0.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("sarathkavuru/anthroly-rl-env-sample", split="train")
ns = {}
exec(ds[0]["grader"], ns)
print(ns["grade"](ds[0]["reference_solution"]))

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download sarathkavuru/anthroly-rl-env-sample --repo-type dataset --local-dir anthroly-rl-env-sample

Evidence

Every grader returns 1.0 on its reference solution and 0.0 on a non-answer.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
